no_adcom_quote.quote: Your application for Lynkuet (elizanetant) capsules was not referred to an FDA advisory committee because outside expertise was not necessary; there were no controversial issues that would benefit from advisory committee discussion.

summary: No FDA advisory committee was convened for NDA219469 (Lynkuet/elinzanetant). The approval letter states the application was not referred to an advisory committee because outside expertise was not necessary and there were no controversial issues warranting AC discussion. Only the approval letter and label are available in paperclip for this application; no multidisciplinary review documents (SumR, CDTL, MedR) were found, and there was no AdComm influence on the approval.
